project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Anti-design chaos board — deliberate rule-breaking on a controlled-chaos baseline: yellow-black warning tape, default blue links, system chrome (ButtonFace gray, Win95 teal, select blue), clashing pure red/green accents, overlapping layers and random-seeded rotations, 5+ mismatched fonts per page, web 1.0 nostalgia (marquee, blink, stuck 99% progress bar). Always ships with a「正常版」readable-mode escape hatch and reduced-motion fallbacks.
